title: NewPiglin
description: You can add what piglins will give you from barter!
body:
# NEW PIGLIN
With this plugin you can change what piglins will give you from barter _with some chance_

## why you must download it?
In internet there are no plugins like this, but I think many servers need it!
This plugin is good for servers that has nether

## installation
you can install plugin on paper, craftbukkit, spigot

## commands
/np_reload - reload config (permission - np.admin)

## settings
you can change what will piglins give and chance of it in config in _./plugins/NoVanila/config.yml_
